patch_description: This redesign separates geometry evaluation, active-constraint analysis, proposal generation, annealing, survivor continuation, and deterministic polishing into modular helpers. It adds geometry-aware correlated two-vertex moves driven by gradients of low-area triangles, while retaining single-point stochastic proposals for basin exploration. The search tracks lexicographic minimum-area/lower-tail quality and uses reheated survivor runs followed by active-set coordinate and pair polishing.
